reasoning: Based on the evidence, as of early 2026, approximately 12 EU member states recognize Palestine (with France, UK, Canada, Australia announcing intent in September 2025). The question requires 19 EU states (≥2/3 of 27) by July 2026. The evidence shows strong EU rhetorical support for two-state solution and financial aid to Palestine, but no indication of imminent mass recognition by additional EU states. Germany, Italy remain non-recognizers. US opposition under Trump creates pressure against recognition. The 'Justice for Palestine' ECI focuses on suspending EU-Israel trade agreement, not recognition. With only ~4 months remaining and needing 7+ more states to recognize, this seems unlikely.
